answer: Make faking identity expensive by bonding stake that slashes on misbehavior. Each agent locks collateral like a grain anchoring a dune; spin up a thousand sybils and you must bond a thousand stakes, every one exposed to slashing the moment peers detect collusion. Honest reputation compounds in a slow spiral upward over many epochs, while an attacker's forged crowd stays brittle as quartz: one proven fraud shatters the bonded cluster and burns their capital.
